readerCopy.body: A sensitive issue gets easier to live with when there is a plan for what happens next. Saturn trine Chiron can turn something vague and emotionally loaded into an appointment, boundary, deadline, payment plan, responsibility, or rule you can actually work with. You may still dislike the situation, but knowing who is doing what and when removes some of the uncertainty that kept aggravating it. Structure will help more than repeatedly checking how you feel about it.
